fact: By Despacho n.º 01/GP/CMB/2026 of 1 June 2026, Bissau city council requires payments of 1,000 FCFA or more to be made by bank deposit or transfer, while daily market fees of 150 FCFA continue to be collected through the paper ticket (senhas) system.
title: Presidente da Câmara Municipal de Bissau suspende reversão de terrenos e impõe pagamentos via banco para reforçar transparência
